them.mo_ta: Numerous additional shrubs and low bushes on the foreground hillside, filling previously open ground between the existing trees, rocks and buildings.
Additional bushes on the upper-right hillside around and beyond the scattered houses and fortifications.
New scattered scrub clumps across the open coastal ground behind the mole and beside the northern fortifications.
Additional bushes across the distant isthmus, including within and alongside the existing long enclosed strips.
Additional individual shrub clumps on the sandy and grassy foreshore outside the western defensive wall, extending from the projecting sandy point toward the bottom-left edge.
Additional small upright trees along the upper end of the rectangular garden beside the western wall; the original garden paths and previously existing trees remain.
Additional discrete exposed boulders and small rocky outcrops scattered across previously open portions of the foreground hillside, beyond the original large foreground rock exposure.
Dense shrubs, bushes and yellow flowering scrub added across the eastern hillside; the green blobs in the render became detailed scrub
White limestone rock outcrops and boulders added on the hillside. The large outcrop replaces the pale patch in the render, and there are smaller rocks higher up
Scrub and bushes added on the coastal strip and dunes west of the walls (q3), and on the beach flats across the bay (q2)
Vegetation texture added to the northern isthmus and the far hills: bushes and trees on the plain, which was smooth green before
Dark underwater rocks or seaweed patch added in the shallows at the bottom-left of the bay

doi_loai_vung.mo_ta: Bottom-left shoreline: the blocky pale shallows and grey-blue edge became smoother turquoise water and a sandy beach. This is a slight coastline softening and the shore may have moved a little.
